calls.head: Bruisers against finesse
calls.body: Philadelphia ranks 8th of 32 for physicality, toward the bruising end; Pittsburgh ranks 31st, toward the finesse end.
calls.call: Philadelphia hits more than Pittsburgh in the close stretches of the game.

calls.happened: On hit score in close games (arena-adjusted, 100 is league average), Philadelphia had 144 and Pittsburgh 131. Coming in, Philadelphia was at 111 and Pittsburgh at 82.

surprises.head: Philadelphia was kept to the outside
surprises.body: Philadelphia needed 27.1 unblocked shots per expected goal at 5-on-5, against its usual 15.1 and a league average of 15.9. Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 250 games.
